persona.primary: A parent (35–55) checking on family between tasks, one-handed, on a phone, often in poor light or low attention. Wants one glance → one verdict.
persona.secondary: A teen/elder family member who is being located — must never feel surveilled; SOS must be operable in panic (gloves, shaking hands, low battery).

hmw: How might a single glance answer 'is everyone okay?' without reading anything?
How might SOS be impossible to miss and impossible to trigger by accident?
How might the app stay silent when everything is fine?
constraints: Svelte 5 runes + scoped CSS + semantic tokens. NO Tailwind, no CSS frameworks.
Initial JS bundle ≤ 120KB gz (size-limit gate); three.js stays a lazy chunk.
Vermilion appears for SOS only. Ember is the sole accent.
Auth rate limit 10 attempts/IP/min — test drivers space logins.
success: Every surface scores ≥ its pre-redesign visual score (delta reported per surface).
Zero hardcoded color/space values where a token exists.
Every screen has empty/loading/error/offline states designed, not defaulted.
reg-final driver stays green; no new pageerrors.
